blocks.text: Polymers are large inorganic or organic molecules with unique properties. Organic polymers are much more common, but inorganic polymers are important in certain applications. Polymers are prepared from a variety of small molecules. Polymers are discussed in detail in Chapter 26.

blocks.explanation: From small molecules (monomers) joined together into very large molecules.

items: Polymers: large organic or inorganic molecules made from small molecules (Chapter 26).
